CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bfr_teacher_lesson_gate_evidence(target_class uuid, target_date date, target_schedule_entry uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(student_id uuid, checked_at timestamp with time zone, entry_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  declare v_subject text; v_day text; v_school_year smallint;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  begin
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    v_day:=case extract(isodow from target_date)::int
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        when 1 then 'segunda' when 2 then 'terca' when 3 then 'quarta'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            when 4 then 'quinta' when 5 then 'sexta' when 6 then 'sabado' else 'domingo' end;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              select e.subject_name,v.school_year into v_subject,v_school_year
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  from public.bfr_schedule_entries e
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      join public.bfr_schedule_versions v on v.id=e.version_id and v.status='published'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          where e.id=target_schedule_entry and e.class_id=target_class and e.weekday=v_day;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            if v_subject is null or not public.bfr_can_manage_lesson_attendance(target_class,v_subject,target_schedule_entry) then
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                raise exception 'Acesso restrito à aula autorizada';
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  end if;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    if extract(year from target_date)::smallint<>v_school_year then raise exception 'Ano incompatível com a grade publicada'; end if;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      return query
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          select gc.student_id,gc.checked_at,gc.entry_status
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              from public.gate_checkins gc
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  join public.students s on s.id=gc.student_id and s.class_id=target_class and s.active
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      where gc.class_id=target_class
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            and coalesce(gc.school_date,(gc.checked_at at time zone 'America/Maceio')::date)=target_date
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  and gc.direction='entry' and gc.entry_status in ('allowed','guardian_present')
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      order by gc.checked_at;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      end $function$

bfr_supervision_frequencia.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bfr_supervision_frequencia(p_mes date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_class_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(ano smallint, turma text, mes text, n_alunos integer, presencas integer, ausencias integer, outros integer, checkins_entrada integer, checkins_saida integer, pct_presenca numeric, pct_ausencia numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid() and p.role in ('secretary'::public.account_role,
      'developer'::public.account_role,'director'::public.account_role)) then
    raise exception 'permissão negada' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return query
  with att as (
    select s.class_id, date_trunc('month', a.attendance_date)::date as mes,
           count(*) filter (where a.status = 'present')::int as presencas,
           count(*) filter (where a.status = 'absent')::int as ausencias,
           count(*) filter (where a.status not in ('present','absent'))::int as outros
    from public.attendance a
    join public.students s on s.id = a.student_id
    where (p_mes is null or date_trunc('month', a.attendance_date)::date = date_trunc('month', p_mes)::date)
      and (p_class_id is null or s.class_id = p_class_id)
    group by s.class_id, date_trunc('month', a.attendance_date)::date
  ), chk as (
    select s.class_id, date_trunc('month', g.checked_at)::date as mes,
           count(*) filter (where g.direction = 'entry')::int as entrada,
           count(*) filter (where g.direction = 'exit')::int as saida
    from public.gate_checkins g
    join public.students s on s.id = g.student_id
    where (p_mes is null or date_trunc('month', g.checked_at)::date = date_trunc('month', p_mes)::date)
      and (p_class_id is null or s.class_id = p_class_id)
    group by s.class_id, date_trunc('month', g.checked_at)::date
  )
  select c.year, c.class_code, to_char(m.mes, 'YYYY-MM'),
         (select count(*)::int from public.students s2 where s2.class_id = c.id and s2.active),
         m.presencas, m.ausencias, m.outros, m.entrada, m.saida,
         round(100.0 * m.presencas / nullif(m.presencas + m.ausencias, 0), 1),
         round(100.0 * m.ausencias / nullif(m.presencas + m.ausencias, 0), 1)
  from public.classes c
  left join (
    select coalesce(att.class_id, chk.class_id) as class_id, coalesce(att.mes, chk.mes) as mes,
           coalesce(att.presencas, 0) as presencas, coalesce(att.ausencias, 0) as ausencias,
           coalesce(att.outros, 0) as outros,
           coalesce(chk.entrada, 0) as entrada, coalesce(chk.saida, 0) as saida
    from att full join chk on chk.class_id = att.class_id and chk.mes = att.mes
  ) m on m.class_id = c.id
  where (p_class_id is null or c.id = p_class_id)
  order by c.year, c.class_code, 3;
end $function$

bfr_supervision_comparativo.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bfr_supervision_comparativo(p_school_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_term smallint DEFAULT NULL::smallint, p_subject text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(ano smallint, turma text, n_alunos integer, n_avaliacoes integer, media numeric, pct_critico numeric, pct_atencao numeric, pct_desenvolvimento numeric, pct_adequado numeric, presencas integer, ausencias integer, pct_presenca numeric, pct_ausencia numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_crit numeric; v_aten numeric; v_dev numeric;
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid() and p.role in ('secretary'::public.account_role,
      'developer'::public.account_role,'director'::public.account_role)) then
    raise exception 'permissão negada' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  select critical_max, attention_max, development_max into v_crit, v_aten, v_dev
  from public.learning_indicator_settings
  where school_year = coalesce(p_school_year,
    (select max(school_year) from public.learning_indicator_settings))
  order by school_year desc limit 1;
  if v_crit is null then v_crit := 49; v_aten := 69; v_dev := 79; end if;
  return query
  with medias as (
    select g.student_id, g.subject, g.term, avg(g.score) as media
    from public.grades g
    join public.students s on s.id = g.student_id
    where (p_subject is null or g.subject = p_subject)
      and (p_term is null or g.term = p_term)
      and (p_school_year is null or exists (
        select 1 from public.classes cc where cc.id = s.class_id and cc.year = p_school_year))
    group by g.student_id, g.subject, g.term
  ), med_turma as (
    select s.class_id,
           count(distinct m.student_id)::int as n_av,
           count(*)::int as n_avaliacoes,
           round(avg(m.media)::numeric, 2) as media,
           count(*) filter (where m.media < v_crit)::int as n_crit,
           count(*) filter (where m.media >= v_crit and m.media < v_aten)::int as n_aten,
           count(*) filter (where m.media >= v_aten and m.media < v_dev)::int as n_dev,
           count(*) filter (where m.media >= v_dev)::int as n_adeq
    from medias m
    join public.students s on s.id = m.student_id
    group by s.class_id
  ), att_turma as (
    select s.class_id,
           count(*) filter (where a.status = 'present')::int as presencas,
           count(*) filter (where a.status = 'absent')::int as ausencias
    from public.attendance a
    join public.students s on s.id = a.student_id
    group by s.class_id
  )
  select c.year, c.class_code,
         (select count(*)::int from public.students s2 where s2.class_id = c.id and s2.active),
         coalesce(mt.n_avaliacoes, 0), coalesce(mt.media, 0),
         round(100.0 * coalesce(mt.n_crit, 0) / nullif(mt.n_av, 0), 1),
         round(100.0 * coalesce(mt.n_aten, 0) / nullif(mt.n_av, 0), 1),
         round(100.0 * coalesce(mt.n_dev, 0) / nullif(mt.n_av, 0), 1),
         round(100.0 * coalesce(mt.n_adeq, 0) / nullif(mt.n_av, 0), 1),
         coalesce(at.presencas, 0), coalesce(at.ausencias, 0),
         round(100.0 * coalesce(at.presencas, 0) / nullif(coalesce(at.presencas, 0) + coalesce(at.ausencias, 0), 0), 1),
         round(100.0 * coalesce(at.ausencias, 0) / nullif(coalesce(at.presencas, 0) + coalesce(at.ausencias, 0), 0), 1)
  from public.classes c
  left join med_turma mt on mt.class_id = c.id
  left join att_turma at on at.class_id = c.id
  where (p_school_year is null or c.year = p_school_year)
  order by c.year, c.class_code;
end $function$

confirm_guardian_entry.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.confirm_guardian_entry(target_checkin uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(checkin_id uuid, student_id uuid, official_name text, class_label text, direction text, checked_at timestamp with time zone, entry_status text, guardian_confirmed_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin if not public.is_gatekeeper() then raise exception 'Acesso restrito ao porteiro'; end if; update public.gate_checkins as gc set entry_status = 'guardian_present', guardian_present = true, guardian_confirmed_by = auth.uid(), guardian_confirmed_at = now() where gc.id = target_checkin and gc.entry_status = 'blocked'; if not found then raise exception 'A entrada já foi liberada ou não foi encontrada'; end if; update public.gate_entry_alerts as gea set acknowledged_at = coalesce(gea.acknowledged_at, now()), acknowledged_by = coalesce(gea.acknowledged_by, auth.uid()), resolved_at = now(), resolved_by = auth.uid() where gea.checkin_id = target_checkin; return query select gc.id, s.id, s.official_name, concat(c.year, 'º ano ', c.class_code), gc.direction, gc.checked_at, gc.entry_status, gc.guardian_confirmed_at from public.gate_checkins as gc join public.students as s on s.id = gc.student_id join public.classes as c on c.id = gc.class_id where gc.id = target_checkin; end; $function$
